chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Steele idolized Coleman Hawkins
summary: Danny teased Steele that Hawkins was in town, and Steele told everybody at the Rhythm Club.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Yeah, he respected musicians. He would respect everybody. I used to bug... I bugged him once. I said... He was crazy about Hawk. "Who was the greatest?" And he'd talk about the greatness... He was his idol. He worshipped...idol...idolized...

And they'd say, "Hawk is in Europe." I said, "I heard Hawk is in town." He went around to the Rhythm Club, because he didn't think I'd lie, man, tellin' everybody he'd heard Hawk's in town. He didn't say who it was. But Hawk wasn't in town. That's how he was. He was an idol of the musicians. And he was nice.
He was really a nice cat, man. I really...
